messages.subject: xlsx package
parts:
I see that the xlsx package (and the xlsxjars package) does not build due to an unresolved dependency.  Are there any alternatives to that package?  Or is there, perhaps, some documentation that might allow us to package our input data in a fashion that existing scripts might be able to use?

 

Thanks
